$comment: Frozen inputs of the 0.12.0 ledger (hds#462), read by scripts/upgrade/build-ledger.mjs. 0.12.0 shipped before ledgers existed, so its record was written after the fact from its snapshot (docs/api/releases/0.12.0.json) and its CHANGELOG section. Each CHANGELOG.md:<line> is numbered as the file read when 0.12.0 shipped (its section starts on line 3); its needle is the text that finds the line, and opens with the commit of the entry when the entry names one. npm no longer serves the tarballs up to 0.13.0, so the snapshots up to that release were read from the source tree at its git tag (snapshot.mjs --source), which reads to the same snapshot as the tarball less its css section (checked against the 0.13.1 to 0.16.0 tarballs). The Hds prefix rename (254d9eb) sits in the 0.12.0 section, and its entry says those families shipped in 0.12.0/0.13.0. The snapshots decide it: no snapshot exports any of the 13 Hds-prefixed names, and 0.12.0 already exports each new one, so the rename landed before 0.12.0 was published. Its steps reach only code built against unpublished HDS, so they list no fact.
summary: Stat, Field and Card move to the shared tone set and InfoPage is removed; adds dozens of components, /brand and /scroll.

steps.subject: InfoPage
steps.plain: InfoPage and InfoPageProps are removed with no replacement; it was portfolio scaffolding, so delete the code that uses it.

steps.subject: Stat-tone
steps.plain: Stat no longer takes tone="default"; pass tone="neutral" or leave tone out, which renders the same.

steps.subject: Field-tone
steps.plain: Field no longer takes tone="default"; pass tone="neutral" or leave tone out, which renders the same.

steps.subject: StatTone-FieldTone
steps.plain: The StatTone and FieldTone types are removed; use StatProps["tone"] and FieldProps["tone"] instead.

steps.subject: Card-tone-variant
steps.plain: Card's tone prop is split in two: change tone="default" to variant="default" and tone="accent" to variant="accent"; tone="success", "warning" and "danger" stay as they are.

steps.subject: CardProgress-CardMetric-tone
steps.plain: Card.Progress and Card.Metric no longer take tone="default" or tone="accent"; pass tone="neutral", or leave tone out, for the old default look.

steps.subject: Hds-prefix
steps.plain: Twelve component families, such as HdsAlertDialog and HdsDateInput, lost their Hds prefix before any release shipped them, so import each by its bare name (AlertDialog, DateInput).
steps.needle: 254d9eb: Drop the `Hds` prefix from 12 net-new leaf component families

steps.subject: lenis
steps.plain: lenis is a new optional peer dependency, needed only if you use SmoothScroll from the new @hirobius/design-system/scroll subpath.
